{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    cw=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    rot180=[list(reversed(row)) for row in reversed(grid)]
    return [list(grid[i])+cw[i] for i in range(n)]+[ccw[i]+rot180[i] for i in range(n)]
",
 "path": "programs/task-205e6879.py"
}
